title: Vague student management app
user_prompt: Lam cho toi mot app quan ly hoc sinh.

title: Goal without stakeholders
user_prompt: Toi muon them tinh nang bao cao doanh thu de ban lanh dao xem tinh hinh kinh doanh nhanh hon.

title: Contradictory requirements
user_prompt: Toi muon he thong dang nhap that bao mat, nhung nguoi dung khong can nhap mat khau, khong can OTP, khong can email, vao app la dung duoc luon.

title: User asks to code immediately
user_prompt: Tao luon project CRM cho toi, khoi hoi nhieu, cu code day du tinh nang nhu Salesforce.

title: Business rule extraction
user_prompt: Trong app dat phong, khach duoc huy mien phi neu huy truoc 24 gio. Neu huy trong vong 24 gio thi mat 50% tien coc. Neu khach khong den thi mat toan bo tien coc.

title: Vague non-functional requirements
user_prompt: App phai nhanh, dep, bao mat, de dung va scale tot.

title: Multiple actors workflow
user_prompt: Toi can he thong duyet don nghi phep. Nhan vien gui don, truong nhom duyet truoc, HR duyet sau, roi he thong cap nhat so ngay nghi con lai.

title: Unclear data ownership
user_prompt: Toi muon dashboard hien thi so luong khach hang tiem nang, ty le chuyen doi, doanh thu du kien va hieu suat tung nhan vien sales.

title: Solution-first request
user_prompt: Toi muon them AI chatbot vao website ban hang de tang doanh thu.

title: Bug impact analysis
user_prompt: Khach hang bao doi khi thanh toan thanh cong nhung don hang van o trang thai chua thanh toan.

title: Scope creep detection
user_prompt: Ban dau toi chi can app ghi chu ca nhan. Nhung them luon chat nhom, quan ly task, lich hop, video call, AI tom tat, CRM mini va marketplace plugin.

title: Planner handoff readiness
user_prompt: Toi muon xay MVP app quan ly thu vien cho truong cap 2. Thu thu co the them sach, hoc sinh muon/tra sach, he thong canh bao sach qua han. Chi can ban MVP trong 2 tuan.
